note: The workflow of the integration's README: `recall` and `remember` are built around one `SdkClient`, and when a call fails without a session both set `client.session_token` to the token of the run's `agent_id`. The client lives as long as the compiled graph, so concurrent runs for different agents overwrite each other's token and read or write another agent's memories. `SdkClient` is reduced to the methods the nodes call.

fixed.fix_note: The nodes take a client per agent id from a cache and set up the session on that client.
